voicecaptions.screen.title: Voice Captions
voicecaptions.button.check.tooltip: Saves settings and sends one second of silence to the server. The first request after the server starts can take 10-15 s while the model loads.
voicecaptions.button.preview.tooltip: Saves settings and shows a sample caption above the nearest player (or above you: press F5 to see it).
voicecaptions.option.enabled.tooltip: Turns recognition and captions on or off. Can also be bound to a key in Controls.
voicecaptions.option.only_audible.toolti: Skip players you muted or turned down to zero in Plasmo Voice.
voicecaptions.option.endpoint.tooltip: Used only in «Own server» mode. OpenAI-compatible transcription URL, for example Lemonade http://127.0.0.1:13305/v1/audio/transcriptions or whisper.cpp http://127.0.0.1:8080/inference
voicecaptions.option.model.tooltip: Model name your server expects. whisper.cpp ignores it.
voicecaptions.option.language.tooltip: Language code such as ru or en; empty means auto-detect. The NPU server (FastFlowLM) always detects the language itself.
voicecaptions.option.timeout.tooltip: How long to wait for one phrase to be recognized.
voicecaptions.option.max_queue.tooltip: When more phrases wait than this, the oldest are skipped so captions stay current.
voicecaptions.option.silence_gap.tooltip: Silence after which a phrase is sent for recognition.
voicecaptions.option.max_phrase.tooltip: Long speech is cut at a quiet moment after this many seconds, so captions appear without waiting for the end.
voicecaptions.option.max_width.tooltip: Maximum text width before wrapping, in GUI pixels at normal size.
voicecaptions.option.max_lines.tooltip: Older lines are hidden behind an ellipsis when the bubble is full.
voicecaptions.option.caption_seconds.too: Base time a phrase stays on screen; longer phrases stay a bit longer (up to 15 s).
voicecaptions.option.max_distance.toolti: Captions of players farther away are not shown.
voicecaptions.option.text_scale.tooltip: Bubble size for a player standing next to you (1 = normal GUI text).
voicecaptions.option.far_scale.tooltip: Share of the near size used at the max distance.
voicecaptions.option.height_offset.toolt: How many blocks above the name tag the bubble sits. Raise it if it covers the Plasmo Voice icon.
voicecaptions.option.through_walls.toolt: Voice carries through walls, so captions do too by default. Turn off to show only players you can see.
Animated dots while a player talks or the phrase is being recognized.
voicecaptions.option.show_name.tooltip: Adds the speaker's name on top of the bubble; useful in crowds or when name tags are hidden.
voicecaptions.error.endpoint: address must start with http:// or https://
voicecaptions.error.language: use a 2-3 letter code like ru, or leave empty
voicecaptions.error.save: Could not save settings. Check that the config folder is writable.
voicecaptions.error.unavailable: Recognition server does not answer at %s. Start it or switch the engine to «Auto».
voicecaptions.error.timeout: Server did not answer in %s s. Increase the timeout or use a smaller model.
voicecaptions.error.http: Server returned HTTP %s. Check the address and model name.
voicecaptions.error.bad_endpoint: Address is not a valid URL: %s
voicecaptions.error.dropped: Skipped: too many phrases in the queue.
voicecaptions.test.sample: This is how captions look. Long phrases wrap onto new lines and older lines fade away.
voicecaptions.test.self: Example shown above you. Press F5 to see it.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.voicecapt: Captions above players' heads for Plasmo Voice, recognized by a local Whisper server.
voicecaptions.option.engine.tooltip: Auto: uses the NPU server (FastFlowLM) when it runs, otherwise starts Whisper on this PC's graphics card. Own server: sends speech only to the address you enter. Speech never leaves this PC in Auto mode and is not saved.
voicecaptions.option.gpu_model.tooltip: Whisper model for the graphics card. Turbo recognizes Russian best and needs about 0.9 GB of video memory; Small and Base are lighter and faster but make more mistakes.
voicecaptions.button.install.tooltip: Downloads whisper.cpp with Vulkan (works on NVIDIA, AMD and Intel) from github.com/lemonade-sdk and the chosen model from huggingface.co/ggerganov into the voicecaptions folder of the game. Files are checked by SHA-256.
voicecaptions.button.open_folder.tooltip: Downloaded files, models and engine.log live here. Delete the folder to free the space.
voicecaptions.engine.downloading_runtime: downloading the GPU engine %s%% (%s of %s MB)
voicecaptions.engine.unsupported: no NPU server, and the GPU engine needs Windows x64
voicecaptions.engine.not_installed: no NPU server; the GPU engine (%s) is not downloaded
voicecaptions.engine.gpu_idle: graphics card, %s, starts when you join a world
voicecaptions.engine.already_installed: The GPU engine with %s is already installed.
voicecaptions.engine.install_started: Downloading the GPU engine with %s. Progress: /voicecaptions engine
voicecaptions.engine.install_running: A download is already running. Progress: /voicecaptions engine
voicecaptions.error.not_installed: No NPU server found, and the GPU engine is not downloaded yet. Open /voicecaptions → Recognition → «Download for GPU» (about %s MB).
voicecaptions.error.unsupported: No NPU server found, and the built-in GPU engine works only on Windows x64. Switch the engine to «Own server».
voicecaptions.error.engine_failed: GPU engine did not start: %s. Details are in voicecaptions/engine.log.
voicecaptions.link.install.hover: Downloads whisper.cpp (Vulkan) and the selected model into the game's voicecaptions folder, then starts recognition.
voicecaptions.engine.install_done: GPU engine downloaded. Recognition starts in a few seconds.
